response.original_title: Rock and Reel: A Film About Monticello's Black Fiddlers
response.overview: Grounded in Virginia’s storied history, seldom-told tales of three generations of musicians blend in this fascinating documentary exploring Black fiddlers. Their virtuosity, first heard at Monticello, echoes forward decades later as contemporary Virginian musicians gather in the University of Virginia Rotunda to honor this legacy.
response.title: Rock and Reel: A Film About Monticello's Black Fiddlers
